agentSettings.subtitle: Defaults for models, workspace, sampling, and how responses are shown.
agentSettings.sectionDesc: Changes are written to your gateway config file. Some values apply on the next agent turn or session.
agentSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to load and change agent defaults.

routeIntro.workspace: Working directory for agent files and limits for inbound images in the image tool.
routeIntro.browser: Let the agent drive the web via browser_use. Enable tools, pick a connection method, then finish setup below.
routeIntro.runtime: Per-turn time limits, tool call depth, request retries, and consecutive tool failure caps.
routeIntro.context: Context compaction and tool-result pruning before messages reach the model.
routeIntro.memory: Memory snapshots, session_search summary model, and optional background review.
routeIntro.tools: Optional tools (web_extract, delegate_task, execute_code), global built-in tool access, and extension params JSON. Available skills are under Skills.
routeIntro.skills: Skills marketplace source (use the section Save button) and default available skills for all agents (use the page header Save). Install skills in the Skills library. Per-tool toggles are under Tools.
routeIntro.systemPrompt: Optional prompt customization for the selected agent profile.
routeIntro.modelStrategy: Global Chat and fixed-intent model defaults inherited by every agent.
routeIntro.generation: Control response length, randomness, thinking level, reasoning visibility, and verbosity.

agentSettings.cardModelsSubtitle: Primary model used by new sessions.
agentSettings.cardWorkspaceSubtitle: Working directory and inbound media limits
agentSettings.cardBrowserSubtitle: browser_use — semantic observation and verified actions through Extension, Playwright, CDP, or Remote drivers
agentSettings.cardGenerationSubtitle: Token budget, randomness, and tool loop depth

desc.modelFallbacks: Tried in order when the primary model returns an error after transient retries. Requires API keys for each provider.
desc.smallModel: Optional cheaper/faster tier for lightweight workflow steps. Leave blank to fall back to the primary model.
desc.smallModelFallbacks: Tried in order when the small primary fails. Requires API keys for each provider.
desc.imageModel: Optional. Used for image understanding / vision. Only models the gateway marks as accepting image input are listed.
desc.imageModelFallbacks: Tried in order when the primary vision model fails. Only models flagged as image-capable are listed.
desc.imageGenerationModel: Optional. For image_generate. Only providers the gateway reports as configured (API keys present) are listed.
desc.imageGenerationModelFallbacks: Tried in order when the primary image generation model fails. Only configured image-generation providers are listed.
desc.mediaMaxMb: Max size when loading images in the image tool.
desc.maxTokens: Maximum tokens in the model response.
desc.maxToolIterations: Maximum tool calls per user message.
desc.thinkingDefault: Default thinking level for new sessions.
desc.reasoningDefault: Whether to surface model reasoning in the chat UI. Per-session overrides (e.g. /reasoning) take precedence until cleared.
desc.verboseDefault: Agent verbosity for logs/tool detail elsewhere — not the reasoning/thinking panel. Use Reasoning visibility to hide reasoning.

agentSettings.visionRegistryEmpty: No models flagged as image-capable for your configured providers. Add `input` including "image" in models.json, or pick a provider model that exposes image input.
agentSettings.visionOutOfFilterNote: Registry does not mark this model as image-capable; choose a vision model when possible.
agentSettings.imageGenRegistryEmpty: No image generation providers are configured with API credentials. Add keys for a provider (e.g. OpenAI) in config or environment, then refresh.
agentSettings.imageGenOutOfFilterNote: This model’s provider is not configured with credentials; image_generate will fail until you configure it or pick a configured provider.

advanced.cardLimitsSubtitle: Wall-clock cap per user turn, request retries, and tool failure budget.
advanced.maxTaskDurationMsDesc: Per-user-turn wall time for LLM and tools. Leave empty to use the 4-hour server default. Range 1–1440 min (1 min–24 h).
advanced.maxRequestsPerTurnDesc: LLM request attempts per user message (reliability; default 50).
advanced.maxToolFailuresPerTurnDesc: Consecutive tool errors before giving up (default 3).
advanced.cardSessionSearchSubtitle: Model used to summarize past sessions for the session_search tool.
advanced.sessionSearchSummaryModelDesc: e.g. openai/gpt-4o-mini. Leave empty to use runtime defaults.
advanced.cardWebExtractSubtitle: Optional model and length for markdown web extraction.
advanced.webExtractModelDesc: Leave empty to use the default provider/model for extraction.
advanced.delegateEnabledDesc: When on, the agent may delegate to sub-agent runs (if supported).
advanced.executeCodeEnabledDesc: When on, the sandboxed code tool is available (if the runtime allows).
advanced.cardSkillsSubtitle: When non-empty, only these skills appear in <available_skills> in the prompt.
advanced.skillsAllowlistDesc: Only checked skills appear in <available_skills>. Leave empty for a clean default context; shared settings can declare their own visible skills.
advanced.cardToolsDisableSubtitle: Control built-in tool access for agent settings or shared settings (e.g. exec_command, web_search).
advanced.toolsDisableHint: Checked tools are available to the default agent; unchecked tools are blocked. Per-agent overrides in Agents still apply.
advanced.toolsDisableEmptyBuiltin: No built-in tools returned by the gateway.
advanced.cardParamsSubtitle: Opaque key/value for extensions. Must be a JSON object.
advanced.paramsJsonDesc: e.g. {"myFlag": true}. Clear to remove params from the config file.
advanced.paramsInvalidJson: Params must be valid JSON object (e.g. empty or {}). Check syntax.

agentSettings.modelsOverrideHint: Chat and fixed-intent models are inherited by every agent unless explicitly overridden.
agentSettings.modelResolutionAgentInherits: Inherited from shared settings when this agent uses one.
agentSettings.modelResolutionSessionSelectable: The chat page can select a temporary session model.

agentsSettings.title: Agents
agentsSettings.subtitle: Manage each agent's identity, workspace, models, tools, skills, and routing.
agentsSettings.needToken: Save a gateway token to manage agents.
agentsSettings.tuiDefaultAgentHint: Used by new terminal UI sessions when no agent is specified. Existing sessions and gateway routing are unchanged.
agentsSettings.tuiDefaultAgentUnavailable: Configured agent "{{agentId}}" is unavailable. Choose another agent to save a working default.
agentsSettings.tuiDefaultAgentInvalid: Choose an available agent for the TUI default.
agentsSettings.selectAgentHint: Choose an entry to edit. Profile Markdown (SOUL.md, IDENTITY.md, …) is read from that agent's `agents/<id>/profile/` directory.
agentsSettings.editAgentHint: Updates agents.list on the gateway. Paths are expanded (~ → home).

inheritance.title: Configuration sources
inheritance.subtitle: See whether key runtime fields come from shared settings or this agent's own settings.

agentsSettings.agentDescriptionPlaceholder: Short summary shown on agent cards and in pickers (optional).
agentsSettings.modelSmallHint: Optional fast-intent override. Leave blank to inherit the global fast model.
agentsSettings.addAgentHint: Same as CLI agents add: creates directories and seeds profile Markdown templates.
agentsSettings.newAgentIdPlaceholder: Leave empty to derive from display name
agentsSettings.newAgentIdRules: 1–64 characters: letters, digits, underscores, hyphens; must start with a letter or digit. Avoid reserved ids (e.g. main, con).
agentsSettings.filesHint: Editable persona files (SOUL, IDENTITY, …). Changes save automatically after you stop typing; use Preview to render Markdown.
agentsSettings.confirmDelete: Remove this agent from config? Bindings referencing it will be stripped.
agentsSettings.confirmDeletePurge: Remove this agent and delete its workspace + ~/.xopc/agents/<id> data? This cannot be undone.
agentsSettings.purgeConfirmLabel: Type the agent id to confirm
agentsSettings.purgeConfirmHint: This action is irreversible. Enter {{agentId}} exactly to enable deletion.
agentsSettings.toolsHint: Tool access for this agent. Tools blocked by shared settings cannot be re-enabled here.

toolDescriptions.read_file: Read text and small files inside the agent workspace (paths are restricted to the workspace sandbox).
toolDescriptions.write_file: Create new files or overwrite existing ones under the workspace.
toolDescriptions.apply_patch: Apply strict multi-file patches for focused source changes.
toolDescriptions.list_dir: List files and subfolders in a workspace directory.
toolDescriptions.grep: Search file contents with regular expressions (similar to ripgrep).
toolDescriptions.find: Find files by name or glob pattern under the workspace.
toolDescriptions.exec_command: Run commands with workspace context; high impact, so disable for read-only or safer agents.
toolDescriptions.update_plan: Update the visible multi-step coding plan for the current turn.
toolDescriptions.web_search: Search the public web for facts and pages newer than the model may know.
toolDescriptions.web_fetch: Fetch a URL and read its text content for the model.
toolDescriptions.browser_use: Unified browser automation tool for semantic observation, verified clicks, typing, tab operations, and screenshot fallback.
toolDescriptions.send_message: Send outbound chat messages on connected channels (e.g. Telegram, CLI, gateway) when the agent replies.
toolDescriptions.send_media: Send images or other media attachments through those channels.
toolDescriptions.user_context_search: Search active user facts, goals, priorities, and collaboration rules.
toolDescriptions.user_context_get: Load one user-model object by id.
toolDescriptions.knowledge_search: Search episodic, project, and workspace knowledge visible in the current scope.
toolDescriptions.knowledge_get: Load one knowledge item by id.
toolDescriptions.knowledge_write: Propose or save scoped knowledge with provenance and lifecycle metadata.
toolDescriptions.memory_maintenance: Run deterministic temporal, reconciliation, or archive maintenance.
toolDescriptions.session_search: Search across saved conversation transcripts and per-session summaries.
toolDescriptions.image: Analyze or describe images (vision) from the workspace or the current turn.
toolDescriptions.image_generate: Generate images using the configured image / image-generation model.
toolDescriptions.extensions: Expose tools registered by enabled extensions — disable to block all extension tools.
toolDescriptions.bundle-mcp: Load tools from configured MCP servers, including installed Connectors.

agentsSettings.skillsHint: These skills appear in this agent's Chat / menu and <available_skills>. Other skills are hidden from the agent. Inherit uses shared settings; customize sets this agent's skills.
agentsSettings.modelsTabHint: Override Chat or a fixed model intent only when this agent must differ from the global defaults.
agentsSettings.channelsHint: config.bindings rows for this agent. Removing a rule updates the full bindings array on the gateway.
agentsSettings.channelsManualChannelHint: Gateway returned no channel list. Enter a channel id (e.g. telegram, webchat, gateway).
agentsSettings.channelsRefreshSessionsHint: Reload recent sessions for this channel
agentsSettings.channelsNoSessionsHint: No session history for this channel yet. Send a message or enter a custom peer id below.
agentsSettings.channelsCustomPeerHint: If set, overrides the session picker. Supports * globs; see session routing docs.
agentsSettings.cronHint: Isolated cron jobs can pin an agent id for the session key. Jobs without an agent id use the default agent and appear when that agent is selected.
agentsSettings.listSearchPlaceholder: Search by name, id, or workspace
agentsSettings.listNoAgentsYet: No agents yet. Create one to get started.

agentsSettings.capabilitiesHint: Choose what this agent can use. Tool access and installed skills belong to this agent, even though user memory is shared.
agentsSettings.runtimeWorkspaceHint: Files and Markdown workspace used when this agent runs.
agentsSettings.advancedHint: Inspect source files, inheritance, and effective configuration. These controls are intended for advanced setup and diagnosis.
agentsSettings.advancedRuntimeCoverageHint: Effective configuration shows the merged manifest. Whether every field is enforced depends on current runtime support.
agentsSettings.personaHint: Set up your agent's identity and personality with a friendly form. For raw Markdown, use Profile Markdown.
agentsSettings.personaSectionUserHint: Help your agent know you better
agentsSettings.avatarRowHint: Pick a style or upload a custom image.
agentsSettings.avatarUploadFailed: Upload failed. Try a smaller PNG, JPEG, or WebP.
agentsSettings.avatarInvalidImage: Use a PNG, JPEG, or WebP image.
agentsSettings.avatarTooLarge: Image must be at most 512 KB.
agentsSettings.personaNotesPlaceholder: Anything else your agent should know about you…
agentsSettings.personaTemplateHint: Templates provide a starting point. You can refine the behavior instructions below without switching to a separate mode.
agentsSettings.personaMemoryNote: Your agent will automatically remember preferences you share in conversation (like favorite foods or habits). No need to add those here.
agentsSettings.sharedUserContextTitle: User memory is shared across agents
agentsSettings.sharedUserContextHint: Your profile, preferences, and long-term memory are managed once and made available to every agent. This page only changes this agent's identity and behavior.
agentsSettings.overviewRuntimeHint: Model and workspace used for new sessions.
agentsSettings.overviewCapabilitiesHint: Review the tools, skills, memory, and connections available to this agent.
agentsSettings.dangerZoneHint: These actions cannot be undone. Be careful.
agentsSettings.dangerZoneBody: Removing the entry hides this agent from the list. Purging disk data also removes local files and profile content.
agentsSettings.dangerZoneMainUnavailable: Main is the fallback agent and cannot be deleted here.
agentsSettings.effectiveHint: Review the actual runtime settings after shared settings and this agent's own settings are merged, with source attribution.
agentsSettings.effectiveNoOverrides: No configuration layer overrides an earlier value.
agentsSettings.effectiveNoToolPolicies: No explicit tool access settings. Unlisted tools follow system defaults and runtime availability.
agentsSettings.presetSetupSubtitle: Choose agents to create. Each comes with a tailored personality and workspace. You can customize them later.
agentsSettings.templateBlankDesc: Start from scratch with an empty profile.
agentsSettings.tryInChatHint: Save and open a new conversation with this agent.
agentsSettings.duplicateAgentHint: Select one to copy its settings and profile files, then adjust the name, ID, and workspace.
agentsSettings.copyFromExistingAgentNone: Do not copy; create a new agent
